news.title: TP Vision brings the magic of Philips Ambilight into the room with AmbiScape
TPV Launches Philips Audio on JioMart and Zepto, Marking Brand’s Entry into Quick Commerce in India

insights.one_liner: TP Vision is the Amsterdam-based company that designs and sells Philips-brand TVs under licence, an IND-recognised sponsor with sales internships.

culture.text: It develops, makes and markets Philips TVs in Europe and other regions, and is fully owned by TV and monitor maker TPV.
Staff often studied computer science, business or electronics engineering, at schools including Prague University of Economics, Ghent University and VU Amsterdam.
Its 2 open jobs here are both sales internships in Amsterdam.

open.text: TP Vision Europe B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Both current postings are open to people who don't speak Dutch.

growth.text: Founded in 2012; it says it employs close to 2,000 people worldwide, while LinkedIn shows 878 on its page.
It launched AmbiScape, bringing Philips Ambilight lighting into the wider room.
